stories.title: More than 3,000 young people in north Wales have had a first meningitis B jab
stories.summary: More than 3,000 young people across north Wales have had a first dose of the meningitis B vaccine in the first two weeks of the campaign, Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has said. stories.title: Former Flint mayor raises £500 for Wales Air Ambulance
stories.summary: The former Mayor of Flint has handed over £500 to the Wales Air Ambulance. Councillor Russ Davies chose the charity as one of the causes to benefit during his 2025-26 civic year, alongside Mayoress Councillor Norma Davies. The money was raised through a series of events across the year, ending with the Mayor’s Civic Ball.

stories.title: Bailey Hill open day to showcase Mold’s Norman castle site
stories.summary: A free open day is being held at Bailey Hill in Mold on Sunday 16 August. The event runs from 11am to 3pm at the Bailey Hill Centre on Denbigh Road, and admission is free. Visitors will be able to walk the nature paths, hear about the history of the site and see woodworking displays

stories.title: Plans for padel courts in Chester FC car park given the go-ahead by Flintshire Council
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has approved plans for a padel and pickleball centre in the car park at Chester FC on Bumper’s Lane. stories.title: Funded childcare applications for Flintshire two-year-olds open on 1 September
